explained.summary: At the games in the amphitheatre, seeing the same spectacles over and over becomes tiresome. Life as a whole is the same, Marcus says, because everything everywhere is the same stuff repeating. He ends with a weary question, ’How long, then?’, as if wondering how long he’ll be watching the same show.
explained.today: It’s the feeling of scrolling through the same kinds of headlines, rows and viral clips for the hundredth time and realising nothing is really new. Marcus treats that weariness as an honest observation rather than something to fix.
